sample.description: A muscular man crouches in an ancient Egyptian-style chamber, turning a stone combination lock covered in hieroglyphics.
A muscular man stands proudly with crossed arms in front of a rustic forest cabin, with chopped wood and an axe nearby.
A smiling muscular chef in a luxury cabin kitchen presents a tray of freshly baked chocolate chip cookies.
A muscular man poses with crossed arms inside a dramatic luxury cabin filled with warm lighting, plants, and a grand staircase.
A muscular runner finishes a 5K race wearing a shirt that says he runs so he can eat cookies without guilt.
